description: Memory ask gate: denies the first Write that would create a file in a project memory store, so a new memory is the user's decision rather than a side effect, and lets the retry through. An existing memory file, the MEMORY.md index and anything outside a store all pass. Claude only (the path it gates is Claude Code's memory layout). Composed by compose-hooks.sh; every command is a ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ path.
